title: The nucleus tractus solitarius is the first hub of self-representation

statements.text: Vagal inputs are mapped in the nucleus tractus solitarius of the medulla into a detailed representation of the viscera, later re-represented in the insula. The nucleus is the first central hub for self-representation.

sources.locator: 4(b) the unique features of the vagus nerve system
sources.quote: Thus, the NTS serves as the first central hub for self-representation
